services.name: Boating and kayaking.
services.desc: This was fun. We got to get on the boat and cruise down Lekoli River. This is when we saw the a few forest elephants on the banks and one crossing the river. They are pretty skittish - as soon as they smell you, they walk away. We also got to enjoy kayaking from camp to camp. You don’t have to do this but if you like,

services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Between July and August, Zanzibar sits along the migration route of Humpback Whales traveling with their calves from the chilly waters of South Africa toward the warmer currents of Somalia. Seeing a mother and baby breach against a Zanzibari sunset? It’s the kind of moment that lives with you

blurb: Journey to Africa is a boutique Safari company rooted in Africa, planning life-changing Safaris across Eastern and Southern Africa. They specialize in intimate and iconic owner-run camps, raw and remote private conservancies, and mobile camps that follow the migration. Every Safari is thoughtfully designed for the guest based on personal knowledge of the places, people, and landscapes.

quotes.text: Our recent trip to Tanzania with Journey to Africa was amazing! From thrilling wildlife encounters in Serengeti and Tarangire National Parks (where we saw elephants, lions, wildebeest, impalas, zebras, hippos, crocs, giraffe) to a 4 mile hike up Mt Kilimanjaro and a hot air balloon ride over Tarangire, every moment was perfectly orchestrated by Mefi and her team.

This was one of the most memorable, adventurous, breath-taking, and peaceful trips we have taken. Mefi planned out every detail meticulously and ensured we were taken care of by our local guides at every step. We looked forward to working with Mefi at Journey to Africa again for our future adventures.

Mefi and her team planned and executed “the trip of a lifetime.”This is not a comment I make lightly. I travel internationally a few times a year for vacations. From the planning phase of hearing our ideas, and adding her own knowledge, we were able to build one of the best vacations I have ever taken

Every single detail was thoughtfully covered, making the trip seamless and stress-free for everyone. The communication was fantastic from start to finish, and it was clear that Mefi truly cared about making our experience unforgettable.

The trip was incredible, and we loved the places we visited and the activities that Mefi had planned. The accommodations and overall itinerary were spot on, and all of the properties had exceptional staff!
My husband and I recently went on safari and it was truly a life-changing experience. This was largely due to the expertise, organization and enthusiasm of Mefi from Journey To Africa.
